title: Define a trade-off and its properties, then test ours against it (2026-10-25)

Let's take a moment to get a definition  of what a tradeoff is, and what it's properties are. 

Ask three agents to produce a definition and 3 properties separately.

Then let's synthsize and see if our trade-offs actually meet the definition
